subject.title: fix(openai): enable prompt cache keys for Azure

question: Should Azure OpenAI Chat Completions receive automatic `prompt_cache_key` and long-retention defaults after this branch is rebased onto the current provider package layout?
rationale: The upstream contract and live proof support the behavior, but it changes default wire payloads for existing Azure completions users and the branch no longer merges cleanly.

options.title: Accept after current-main port
options.body: Ask for or sponsor a rebase that ports the fix into the current `packages/ai` provider layout and reruns the focused current-main checks before merge.

options.title: Keep explicit compat only
options.body: Decline the default expansion and keep Azure completions users on `compat.supportsPromptCacheKey` until maintainers want a broader provider-default policy.

options.title: Maintainer-adopt the branch
options.body: A maintainer can carry the proof-backed idea into a fresh branch if the contributor cannot resolve the conflict quickly.

recommendation.title: Accept after current-main port
recommendation.body: Ask for or sponsor a rebase that ports the fix into the current `packages/ai` provider layout and reruns the focused current-main checks before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the most recent shared compat and provider-adapter history that the current-main port needs to fit.
